scope: Desktop Task Center restores Word queues after restart; CLI/MCP persistence is outside this feature.

behavior.restore: Read-only probes; no automatic conversion; existing queues are protected.
behavior.retained: Matching existing PDFs remain available, including when the source is missing.
behavior.retry: Only unfinished or missing outputs are prepared; regenerate-all creates new files in the current output directory.
behavior.changes: Explicitly accept a changed Word source; re-add a changed ZIP. Native conversion checks expected SHA-256 against actual input bytes.
behavior.privacy: Allowlisted versioned metadata only. No passwords, watermark contents/images, PDF bytes, job IDs or invocation objects.
behavior.secrets: Previously enabled watermark/encryption controls restore empty and require re-entry or explicit opt-out.
behavior.limits: 20 sources per task; 100 finished records; bounded paths; read-only file checks reject links/reparse points and oversized files.
behavior.legacy: Old records without source metadata retain output locations but require selecting sources again.
behavior.storage: Storage failure is visible. Clear removes metadata only.
behavior.interrupted: Unfinished tasks become interrupted. Progress is saved as received; missing captured fingerprints use the current source during recovery, without a crash-atomic guarantee.
behavior.deleted: No download cache or recovery of deleted source bytes.
